# @keyring-dev/cache

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

The Keyring SDK policy cache: versioned snapshot, delta poller, bounded LRU and snapshot-to-disk. Keeps @keyring-dev/core's verify() fed with no network call on the hot path.
